hook: TANA to Telugu students in US: skip the *Thanksgiving* trip home
hook_b: TANA to Telugu students in US: skip the *Thanksgiving* trip home
tldr: Telugu students in the US are reconsidering Thanksgiving trips to India over visa renewals, immigration scrutiny and flight disruptions; TANA is advising them to stay put.

beats.what: TANA says it has been getting enquiries from students and is advising them to celebrate Thanksgiving in the US.
beats.why: Students whose visa stamps have expired or are due to expire worry about getting fresh appointments; reports of stranded passengers add to it.
beats.care: Students with pending OPT applications are also weighing the risk, which depends on individual status and documents.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Yale (Nov 10), Berkeley and Michigan (Nov 12) have issued travel advisories ahead of the break.

cards.q: Someone in your family studying in the US: are they flying home this break?

qs: Who carries the risk if a student's re-entry is delayed: the student or the university?
Will visa appointment availability change before winter break?

facts.t: *3* US universities, Yale, Berkeley and Michigan, issued travel cautions between Nov 10 and Nov 12.

steps.e: Michigan: visa slots short in some regions
TANA: stay in the US for now

learn.t: OPT = Optional Practical Training, US work permission for students after their course

watch: Further university advisories before the holiday break.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Telugu students in US advised against travelling to India for Thanksgiving

fact: TANA is telling Telugu students in the US to skip *Thanksgiving* trips home.
twist: UC Berkeley's Nov 12 advisory says international travel 'may be high risk' and warns of device inspections at US ports of entry.
